## Install

### macOS

1. Download **{{DMG_NAME}}**, open it, and drag **Clatch** to **Applications**.
2. Open **Clatch** from Applications. It appears in the menu bar (no Dock icon).
3. Click the menu bar icon › **Add Another Account…** to set up your second Claude account.

Universal (**Apple silicon + Intel**), macOS 11 Big Sur or later. Liquid Glass on macOS 26 and later.

### Windows

1. Download **{{EXE_NAME}}** and run it. No administrator rights needed.
2. Clatch appears in the notification area (next to the clock; it may be under the **^** arrow). No taskbar button.
3. Click the icon › **Add Another Account…** to set up your second Claude account.

**x64 and ARM64** in one installer, Windows 10 (1809) or later. Acrylic on Windows 11.
